title: Count Submatrices with Top-Left Element and Sum Less Than k
statement: You are given an integer matrix `grid` (indexed from 0) and an integer `k`. Consider every submatrix (a contiguous block of rows and columns) that includes `grid[0][0]`, the cell in the top-left corner. Count how many of these submatrices have elements adding up to at most `k`, and return that count.
notes:
## Intuition

A submatrix that must contain the top-left cell has to start at row 0 and column 0, so it is fixed entirely by its bottom-right cell `(i, j)`. That leaves only m·n candidates, but adding each one up from scratch costs O(m·n) per candidate. A 2D prefix sum gives each candidate's sum in O(1): the sum of the block ending at `(i, j)` is the cell itself plus the block above it plus the block to its left, minus their overlap, which was counted twice.

## Approach

1. Make `prefix` with one extra row and column of zeros, so `prefix[i + 1][j + 1]` is the sum of the block from `(0, 0)` to `(i, j)` and the borders need no special case.
2. Visit the cells row by row. Fill `prefix[i + 1][j + 1] = grid[i][j] + prefix[i][j + 1] + prefix[i + 1][j] - prefix[i][j]`.
3. If that block sum is at most `k`, it is a valid submatrix: increase `count`.
4. Return `count`.

## Example 1, step by step

`grid = [[7, 6, 3], [6, 6, 1]]`, `k = 18`. Row 0 gives block sums `7`, `7 + 6 = 13` and `13 + 3 = 16`, all at most 18, so `count = 3`. Row 1: at `(1, 0)` the sum is `6 + 7 = 13`, so `count = 4`; at `(1, 1)` it is `6 + 13 + 13 - 7 = 25` and at `(1, 2)` it is `1 + 16 + 25 - 13 = 29`, both too big. The answer is `4`.

## Complexity

- Time: O(m·n): each cell's block sum is built from three earlier ones in constant time.
- Space: O(m·n) for `prefix` (one row of running sums would also do).

## Pitfalls

- Do not count every submatrix: only those whose top-left corner is `grid[0][0]`, one per cell.
- The overlap `prefix[i][j]` is added twice by the two neighbours; subtract it once.
- The bound is inclusive: a sum equal to `k` counts.

## Variables

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `rows`, `cols` | the grid's height and width |
| `prefix` | `prefix[i + 1][j + 1]` is the sum of the block from `(0, 0)` to `(i, j)` |
| `i`, `j` | row and column of the block's bottom-right cell |
| `count` | valid submatrices found so far |
